logo.geometry_provenance_reason: The full and reduced masters embed the two owner-approved authoritative SVG sources unchanged. The single-ink derivative preserves their approved centerlines, stroke widths, caps, joins, and silhouette.

guide.descriptor: Cross-platform desktop companion for The Elder Scrolls Online
guide.foundation: ESO Weave is an offline-first desktop companion. Combat weaving works without an addon. Fishing, Auto Potion, weapon-bar timing, and latency adaptation consume visible PixelBeacon telemetry, while uncertain or unsafe state closes action gates.
personality: Names the observed game or application state
States technical, vendor, and account boundaries
promises: Configured weaving remains scoped to ESO focus.
PixelBeacon-assisted features act only on current observable state.
Missing or unsafe evidence blocks synthesized input instead of inventing certainty.
guide.sharp_edge: Automation may conflict with applicable game terms or lead to account consequences. ESO Weave provides controls and information, while users retain responsibility for use.
guide.logo: The badge-less woven carets identify dark lockups. The existing self-contained badge protects reduced and light-surface uses. Single-ink reproduction uses uninterrupted source centerlines without an artificial crossing segment.
guide.palette: Teal identifies active state and emphasis. Accessible gold identifies actions on light surfaces. Dark ink surfaces keep game and application status primary.
guide.specimen_body: Combat weaving, fishing assistance, Auto Potion, and live status stay visible and operator-controlled without reading game memory or network traffic.
